bootstrap: Paired patient-clustered percentile bootstrap, stratified by outer fold
interval_scope: Conditional test-sampling uncertainty; no model retraining, architecture-selection correction or multiplicity adjustment
primary_reporting: Raw nested selection procedure and prespecified inner-calibrated counterpart reported side by side
AP_definition: Threshold-grouped non-interpolated average precision, verified against sklearn
Brier_definition: Mean sum of squared errors across three classes, range 0 to 2
